title: Hallucination Mitigation for Large Vision-Language Models via Implicit Feature Stabilization
abstract: arXiv:2608.29924v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) are prone to hallucinations: they fluently describe objects, attributes, and scenes that are not in the image. We connect part of this failure to a measurable property of their representations, feature instability, where mild semantics-preserving perturbations of the input cause large changes in the learned embeddings; hallucination rates rise together with this variability. Existing stability-motivated remedies are explicit, in the sense that they intervene at inference time through latent steering or constrained decoding, and pay for it on every query. We propose implicit stabilization instead: perturbation-invariance is built into the model weights during fine-tuning, and nothing extra runs at deployment. translated_title: 通过隐式特征稳定化缓解大型视觉语言模型的幻觉问题
translated_abstract: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）容易产生幻觉：它们会流畅地描述图像中并不存在的物体、属性和场景。我们将这类失败的一部分与其表示中的一个可测量属性——特征不稳定性——联系起来：对输入施加轻微的语义保持扰动会导致学习到的嵌入发生巨大变化，且幻觉率会随这种可变性的上升而升高。现有的基于稳定性的补救方法是显式的，即它们在推理时通过潜在引导或约束解码进行干预，并在每次查询时付出额外代价。我们转而提出隐式稳定化方法：在微调阶段将扰动不变性构建到模型权重中，部署时无需运行任何额外操作。我们的框架INFUSE首先围绕扰动平均锚点和真实锚点稳定视觉和文本表示，然后将稳定后的表示跨模态对齐
tldr: 提出INFUSE框架，在微调阶段将扰动不变性隐式地内建于模型权重中，通过稳定视觉与文本表示并进行跨模态对齐，在不增加任何推理时开销的前提下缓解大型视觉语言模型的幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes INFUSE, a framework that implicitly builds perturbation-invariance into model weights during fine-tuning by stabilizing visual and textual representations around anchors and aligning them across modalities, thereby mitigating hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models without any inference-time overhead.
